blueprint_concepts: Direct and transverse common tangents; length of a common tangent

concept_use.Direct and transverse common tangents; l: Direct and transverse common tangent lengths sqrt(d^2 - (r1 - r2)^2) and sqrt(d^2 - (r1 + r2)^2); their squares differ by 4 r1 r2, which gives r2 = 9 and then d^2.

english: Two circles $C_{1}$ and $C_{2}$ lie outside each other. The radius of $C_{1}$ is $4$. The length of a direct common tangent of $C_{1}$ and $C_{2}$ is $15$ and the length of a transverse common tangent is $9$. If $d$ is the distance between the centres of $C_{1}$ and $C_{2}$, then the value of $d^{2}$ is ______.
hindi: दो वृत्त $C_{1}$ तथा $C_{2}$ एक-दूसरे के बाहर स्थित हैं। $C_{1}$ की त्रिज्या $4$ है। $C_{1}$ तथा $C_{2}$ की एक अनुस्पर्श (direct) उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई $15$ है तथा एक तिर्यक (transverse) उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई $9$ है। यदि $d$ दोनों वृत्तों के केन्द्रों के बीच की दूरी है, तो $d^{2}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: For circles with radii $r_{1},r_{2}$ and centres $d$ apart (outside each other), the lengths of the direct and transverse common tangents are $L_{d}=\sqrt{d^{2}-(r_{1}-r_{2})^{2}}$ and $L_{t}=\sqrt{d^{2}-(r_{1}+r_{2})^{2}}$.
Check with the direct tangent: $d^{2}=225+(9-4)^{2}=250$. Also $d=\sqrt{250}>13=r_{1}+r_{2}$, so the circles are indeed outside each other.
originality_note: New: the unknown radius is eliminated through the invariant L_d^2 - L_t^2 = 4 r1 r2 before d is found (way 4, a hidden invariant). Closest known: length of the direct or transverse common tangent for given radii and distance. Different because: the data run backwards (lengths given, distance asked) and the second radius is unknown.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked consistency (both formulas give 250) and that the circles are outside each other. Answer 250 is a positive 3-digit integer as planned. No change.
key_step: Subtract the two squared lengths to get 4 r1 r2 = 144.
justification: Two standard formulas and one subtraction; routine but more than one move. Comparable to 2021-P1-Q18 (L2) in demand.
